abilities.name: Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash
_curatorNotes: Generator had behavior: 'stance'. Changed to 'instant' per recipe — windwheel rolling state is the skill animation itself, not a separate stance window replacing a new N/C string. Normals are unavailable during the roll only because the roll IS the cast animation. Reviewer to confirm behavior classification.

gcsim models three skill variants: Press (tap E, 6s CD, cooldownStartDelay=14), ShortHold (brief hold, 6.2s CD, cooldownStartDelay=30, skillShortHoldFrames), and Hold (duration=1–600 frames, variable CD = 6 + duration/120 s, parameterized frames: skillHoldFrames[next] - 600 + duration). Hold variant above uses ShortHold frames (swap=87) and CD (6.2s) as representative; cooldownStartDelay=30 not representable in variant schema. Full-hold at max duration (hold=600): swap=706, D=708, J=708, CD=11s, cooldownStartDelay=650.

Elemental Absorption on Hold E (ShortHold and Hold variants only): absorbs Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo once per use; adds elemental DoT ticks (skillAbsorb mult, ICDTagElementalArtAnemo) and elemental kick bonus (skillAbsorbEnd mult, ICDTagNone). Not modeled — reviewer to decide effect-row representation. Note: absorption is on the skill, not the burst — recipe section 3.5 covers burst absorption only.

C2 (Egress Prep): Press kick gets base +3.3% DMG; each 0.5s in windwheel state adds +3.3% (max 66%). Implemented in gcsim via c2Bonus counter on AttackTagElementalArt hits. Likely: onCast with skill condition for the Press base; periodic accumulation during windwheel for the stacking portion. trigger:manual inherited on any generator effects — reviewer to author.
abilities.description:
The special technique of the Yoohoo Ninja Arts!
Sayu curls up into a rolling Fuufuu Windwheel and smashes into opponents at high speed, dealing Anemo DMG. When the duration ends, she unleashes a Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick, dealing AoE Anemo DMG.

Press
Enters the Fuufuu Windwheel state, rolling forward a short distance before using the Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick.

Hold
Rolls about continuously in the Fuufuu Windwheel state, increasing Sayu's resistance to interruption while within that state.
During this time, Sayu can control the direction of her roll, and can use the skill again to end her Windwheel state early and unleash a stronger version of the Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick.
The Hold version of this skill can trigger Elemental Absorption.

This skill has a maximum duration of 10s and enters CD once its effects end. The longer Sayu remains in her Windwheel state, the longer the CD.

Elemental Absorption
If Sayu comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro while in her Windwheel state, she will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use of this skill.

abilities.name: Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry

_curatorNotes: gcsim burst.go Burst(): the Daruma tick loop `for i := 145 - tickTaskDelay; i < 145+540-tickTaskDelay; i += 90` runs inside a QueueCharTask at tickTaskDelay=20, so absolute tick frames are 145/235/325/415/505/595 — first tick 145f, interval 90f (1.5s), 6 ticks. Matches the measured row (gcsim-frames-diff §5: Muji-Muji Daruma 145f / 90f × 6).

Scaling from gcsim createBurstSnapshot(): Mult = burstSkill[c.TalentLvlBurst()]; zz_sayu.dm.go burstSkill[9] = 0.936 → 93.6% ATK at talent level 10. Cross-checked against sidecar row 'Muji-Muji Daruma DMG' column 10 = 93.6%. stat 'atk' — the AttackInfo carries no snap override and the C6 rider is added as FlatDmg, not a stat swap.
Element anemo, Durability 25 (1U), ICDTag ICDTagElementalBurst / ICDGroup ICDGroupDefault = standard ICD, so no icdGate annotation (measured verdict 3/6 `standard`).

firstTickDelay = (145 − summon spawnsAt 0) / 60 = 2.417s. The sibling heal on this summon carries 2.42 — the same number at 2dp; not touched, and spawnsAt/duration left exactly as authored per the round's rule.

C0 alternation: gcsim computes needAttack = enemy != nil && (!needHeal || hasC1), so at C0 a tick is EITHER this attack OR the heal, never both. The real gate is 'active character HP > 70%', which has no condition primitive (recipientHpBelow describes the heal's recipient, not this effect's enemy target), so the series is authored ungated — the attack branch is the common-play case (party above 70%) and the caveat covers the alternation. At C1 both fire on every tick; cadence and tick count are identical at every constellation.
C6 (Sleep O'Clock) adds FlatDmg = ATK × min(EM×0.002, 4.0) to this tick — an EM-scaled flat rider with no scaling-buff representation here; unchanged cadence. See the C6 node's notes.

abilities.caveat: Both the Daruma's heal and its attack are drawn on every tick, but at C0 each tick is one or the other: it heals only while the active character is at 70% HP or lower, and attacks otherwise. At C1 it does both at once.
_curatorNotes: Muji-Muji Daruma spawnsAt not sourced from an explicit gcsim constant. Initial AoE hits at burstHitmark=12; first Daruma tick scheduled at frame 145 per gcsim tick loop. Daruma likely spawns near the burst animation end (~frame 65) — no explicit spawn frame constant found; reviewer to confirm spawnsAt.
Daruma duration: gcsim tick loop schedules 6 ticks at frames 145–595 (~9.9s). In-game duration is 12s per genshin-db; using 12s.

On-cast team heal authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10. gcsim burst.go Burst(): c.Core.Player.Heal(Target: -1 = all party) fires immediately; heal = initHealFlat[TL] + ATK×initHealPP[TL], snapshotting ATK + Healing Bonus at cast. TL10: initHealPP[9]=1.65888 (sidecar 'Skill Activation Healing' col 10 = 165.9% ATK), initHealFlat[9]=1270.2417 (sidecar '+1270'). Target 'team'; scales on ATK (not HP).

Daruma periodic heal authored as a summonTick heal on the Muji-Muji Daruma summon (Diona Drunken Mist / Kuki Grass Ring shape). gcsim tick loop: first tick at frame 145, interval 90f (1.5s), exactly 6 ticks (frames 145/235/325/415/505/595; loop `for i:=125; i<665; i+=90`). Summon spawnsAt defaults to 0 → firstTickDelay 145/60 ≈ 2.42s. TL10: burstHealPP[9]=1.437696 (sidecar 'Muji-Muji Daruma Healing' col 10 = 143.8% ATK), burstHealFlat[9]=1100.8761 (sidecar '+1101'). Target 'active' (gcsim heals c.Core.Player.ActiveChar()); scales on ATK.

Tick-count vs duration mismatch: gcsim fires a fixed 6 ticks (loop stops at frame 595 ≈ 9.9s) but the summon duration is authored 12s (genshin-db display) — with firstTickDelay 2.42s + interval 1.5s the renderer derives 7 ticks over 12s. No tickCount primitive to pin the fixed 6; flagged for a future summon-tick-count schema pass.

Heal/damage alternation: per tick gcsim computes needHeal = IsWithinArea && (activeHP ≤ 0.7 || C1) and needAttack = enemy != nil && (!needHeal || C1). At C0 each Daruma tick is EITHER a heal (active char ≤70% HP) OR an Anemo attack (else) — mutually exclusive; C1 ignores the HP limit and does both. Heal gated via recipientHpBelow:70 (null-resolving → renders optimistically per convention) to express the low-HP-active-char targeting. Lowest-HP-target selection and the 'no enemy nearby → heal anyway' branch aren't expressible primitives; caveat covers the alternation.

Daruma attack tick AUTHORED 2026-08-17 (gauge round L5e residue): 93.6% ATK Anemo on the same 145f/90f×6 cadence as the heal, ungated. The earlier decision to withhold it was heal-scoped and pre-dates summon ticks applying their element — leaving it out silently dropped six Anemo applications from every Sayu rotation. Its real gate ('active char HP > 70%') still has no primitive, so it is drawn alongside the heal and the caveat carries the alternation; see the effect's own notes. C6 adds EM-scaled riders (attack +min(EM×0.2%,400%) ATK FlatDmg; heal +min(EM×3,6000) flat) — not composed here; see C6 node notes. Initial cast Anemo AoE DMG rendered via FrameMap, not authored as an effect (corpus convention).

[A7] Summon periodic heal targets the active character; in game it selects the lowest-HP-percentage active character nearby, which is not an expressible targeting primitive (already noted in existing curator residuals).
abilities.description:
The other super special technique of the Yoohoo Ninja Arts! It summons a pair of helping hands for Sayu.
Deals Anemo DMG to nearby opponents and heals all nearby party members. The amount of HP restored is based on Sayu's ATK. This skill then summons a Muji-Muji Daruma.

Muji-Muji Daruma
At specific intervals, the Daruma will take one of several actions based on the situation around it:
·If the HP of nearby characters is above 70%, it will attack a nearby opponent, dealing Anemo DMG.
·If there are active characters with 70% or less HP nearby, it will heal the active character with the lowest percentage HP left. If there are no opponents nearby, it will heal active characters nearby even if they have 70% HP or more.

_curatorNotes: C6 Effect 1 — Scaling buff: Daruma attack bonus scales as EM × 0.2% ATK (max +400% ATK additional DMG to Daruma attacks). value field removed per scaling-buff rule. trigger:manual inherited from generator — likely a continuous modifier on Daruma attacks while Daruma is active (not a discrete triggered buff); target 'self' appears incorrect (Daruma is the actor). Reviewer to author correct representation.

C6 Effect 2 — Scaling heal: Daruma heal bonus scales as EM × 3 HP (max +6000 HP additional heal per tick). Generator modeled as atk% stat which appears incorrect — should be a flat heal increase on the Daruma's heal, not an ATK% buff. value field removed per scaling-buff rule. trigger:manual inherited — reviewer to correct stat and author.
